title: Roleplay console (Wolf Roleplay window)
layout_order: title band (crescent, ROLEPLAY, game name, X; the 34 px drag strip) | hero (portrait with stat rings and level, name, state line, GAME MODE switch, wallet) | tab strip STATS JOURNAL COMBAT BAG PETS GAME LOOK HELP | the page (scrolled, thin scroll bar on the right) | ACTIONS (the game's buttons, 3 or 4 a row) | status line | footer: Leave this game (left), Clear screen effects (right) | modal question card over everything

controls.name: floater
controls.label: floater wolf_roleplay: no close/minimise buttons of its own, resizable (min 540 x 560), position saved, title hidden; its face is the wolf_game_console control 'console'
X (title band)
controls.tip: Close this window (Escape)

case H_CLOSE: if (LLFloater* f = floater()) f->closeFloater(); break;
